evidence: app/package.json:8 — hono ^4.13.14, the current npm latest; avoided the available Hono v5.0.0-rc.1 pre-release
app/src/index.js:4 — serve() is the adapter's long-stable entrypoint, unchanged in @hono/node-server v2 (release notes: "the public API stays the same")
app/src/views/layout.js:1 — hono/html#html tagged template, documented stable helper since Hono v3 (2024-02)
app/src/views/home.js:37-42 — only core htmx attributes with standard delay/changed/from modifiers; no extensions, no moveBefore()
reach.rationale: Every API in the app has been stable for years; the one recently-major'd package (@hono/node-server v2, 2026-04-21) exposes the identical v1 API surface the app uses, and the app declined the Hono v5 RC that its peer range permits.

evidence: app/src/api.js:10-25 — all external HTTP isolated in one data-access module with a memoized cache
app/src/app.js:13-15 — adapter coupling limited to a four-line serveStatic route loop
app/public/app.js:6-10 — the only htmx-specific client hook is one documented configRequest listener; the app degrades to plain form GETs without htmx
app/src/views/home.js:36-42 — htmx attributes are enhancements on a real action/method=get form, so the framework is fully removable
containment.rationale: There is nothing experimental to contain, and even the ordinary coupling (htmx attributes, adapter calls, fetches) is confined to small, swappable seams; dropping htmx entirely would leave a working app.

evidence: app/src/views/layout.js:1 — hono/html template literals chosen over JSX: the documented, stable default
app/scripts/build.mjs:8-11 — htmx vendored from node_modules at build time rather than a CDN; no extensions pulled in
app/src/api.js:22-24 — plain fetch with limit=100000 and in-memory caching instead of any preview helper
app/src/app.js:29-31 — c.html/renderPage wrapper is the only rendering path; no raw() or unstable escapes (grep: zero matches)
justification.rationale: No experimental API is used at all, and every stable API is used in its most boring documented form — nothing is novelty-driven and nothing needs justifying against a stable alternative.

findings.issue: htmx is pinned to the ^2.0.11 line while htmx 4.0.0 (released 2026-08-28) is the current major; the 2.x line is in maintenance mode
findings.suggestion: Plan an upgrade to htmx 4.x — the core attributes used here (hx-get, hx-target, hx-swap, hx-push-url, hx-trigger) and the configRequest event carry over, so the bump should be low-risk; not urgent, since 2.x is still supported

findings.issue: @hono/node-server v2 is a ~6-month-old major on a fast patch cadence that has already shipped a serveStatic security fix (GHSA-rmxm-3fg6-px4f, v2.1.3, 2026-09-29)
findings.suggestion: The app is correctly on the patched 2.1.5; keep the caret range refreshed in CI so future serveStatic/security patches land, and re-read the v2 migration notes if new serveStatic options (e.g. allowPercentInPath) become relevant

summary: The app reaches for essentially zero experimental surface: it runs entirely on long-stable Hono 4 core APIs, hono/html template literals, the v1-era @hono/node-server API (unchanged in the recent v2 major), and vanilla core htmx attributes. It even declined the available Hono v5 RC and stayed a major behind on htmx, which makes it conservative rather than risky. The only currency note is a planned bump to htmx 4.x; experimental-API count is zero and the risk of breaking changes is minimal.
